notes.title: UPDATE #2 | JUMPSCARES FIX, ACCESSIBILITY IMPROVEMENTS AND MORE...
notes.notes:
I think this update fixes the most important issues that stand out the most and break immersion. These things are:

[u][b][list]
[*] Fixed a bug where you could use the camera, batteries, pills or move while dead.

[*] Added information on how to scan anomalies when picking up the camera for the first time.

[*] Fixed an issue where the entity would stand still when spawning in the bathroom.
[/list][/b][/u]

You spot something else that should be fixed or improved? Stop by discord and let me know!

[b][h2][url=https://discord.com/invite/Xfd9RDecTp]DISCORD[/url][/h2][/b]

notes.title: UPDATE #1 | FIXED CAMERA ANIMATIONS, BALANCED SANITY LEVEL AND MORE...
notes.notes:
As I mentioned, for me, the most important thing in my games is that you have fun with them, that they are understandable, and that they are as terrifying as possible.

I decided to fix the things that, in my opinion, were the most common reasons why you couldn’t fully enjoy them due to a lack of comfort while playing and an unbalanced difficulty level. The things I have fixed are:

[u][b][list]
[*] The fear level while using the camera is now balanced and doesn’t increase as quickly as before.

[*] Disabled camera animations when picking up batteries, the camera, and other animations that caused uncomfortable gameplay.

[*] Anomaly scanning is now faster to avoid slowing down the gameplay and to make it more fluid.
[/list][/b][/u]

If there are still any things that bother you or need improvement, let me know on Discord. I’m always active there. I hope this helped, and that you’ll consider leaving a review.

[h2][url=https://discord.gg/Xfd9RDecTp]DISCORD[/url][/h2]
